title: MNCS promotion boundary declaration
description: Versioned declarative contract owned by MNCS. A promotion boundary names the authoritative evidence a candidate revision must carry before it may cross a declared boundary (release, promotion, adoption). The owner-native evaluator (scripts/mncs_promotion_evaluate.py) applies this declaration to check-result evidence; transport layers carry the verdict without reinterpreting it. This contract never hard-codes family membership: any evidence-requirement mechanism extension follows the same required/optional shape.

boundary_id.description: Stable identity of this boundary, echoed in every promotion result.

subject_repository.description: Repository this boundary declaration belongs to. Evidence stamped for another repository never satisfies it.

required_evidence.description: Evidence that must PASS for promotion. A required FAIL blocks (FAIL); required UNKNOWN or missing evidence blocks without a negative finding (UNKNOWN); never PASS.

optional_evidence.description: Evidence that stays visible in unresolved but never decides the boundary. Missing optional evidence has no effect.

require_subject_binding.description: When true, every required check must carry a subject stamp binding it to the candidate revision. Unstamped required evidence is incomplete (UNKNOWN), never PASS; mismatched stamps are contradictory (no claim).

obligation_check_id.description: Check id carrying MNCDS obligation evaluation (default mncds-obligations). Its unresolved entries identify blocking obligations.

tolerated_obligations.description: Obligation keys explicitly tolerated by this boundary policy. Open obligations with these keys do not block. Everything else required-and-open blocks as UNKNOWN.

check_id.description: Expected check-result id. Duplicate check ids in one evaluation are contradictory.

authority.description: Semantic authority that owns this requirement (e.g. machine-native-complexity-development-specification). Recorded for attribution; transport does not verify it beyond echo.

contract_revision.description: Expected contract_revision of the evidence. When present and mismatched, the evidence is incomplete (UNKNOWN), not a negative finding.
